title: Bend shapes: partial release, double bend, hold, slow release
description: Four half notes on string 3, one bend shape each — the shapes the stop grammar makes sayable (core-bend-stops.md). Bar 1: a partial release (0>full>1/2 — the landing is labelled '1/2', because without it a partial release reads as a full one) and a double bend (0>1/2>0>1/2>0). Bar 2: a hold (0>1/2>1/2>0 — the flat segment carries no head) and a slow release (0>full>>>0 — the rise takes a quarter of the note, the release the rest; segment weights are positions in the stored curve, no schema change). Every moving segment arrives VERTICALLY with its arrowhead on the arrival tangent; every arrival off the written pitch is labelled.
